title: Uptake sift disable enable support
summary: Index management pages now support viewing and disabling SIFT indexes on relevant tables, with fixes to primary key references required for platform compatibility.
key_points: Added support for disabling and enabling SIFT indexes in index management UI
Fixed primary key references on index pages to maintain platform compatibility
Updated Indexes List Part and Table Information Card pages
Changes required for proper platform uptake
quote: Uptake the new support for disabling and enabling sift on relevant tables + fixes platform uptake
